title.narrative: 2015 Recommendation concerning the Protection and Promotion of Museums and Collections, their Diversity, and their Role in Society, and UNESCO Museum Programme

description.narrative:
Supporting Museums in Education, Cultural Preservation, and Community Engagement:
Recognizing that Museums, with their rich and diverse collections, play an important role in preserving heritage, fostering dialogue, and offering formal and informal education and outreach to local communities, UNESCO will support Member States with the Protection and Promotion of their Museums and Collections, their Diversity, and their Role in Society for peacebuilding and sustainable development.
The UNESCO Museum Programme will strengthen the role of museums and collections in education, cultural diversity, and social inclusion, with a particular focus on African countries and Small Island Developing States (SIDS). This will be achieved through awareness-raising of the policy guidance of the UNESCO 2015 Recommendation concerning the Protection and Promotion of Museums and Collections, their Diversity, and their Role in Society ("Museum Recommendation"), capacity building in its implementation, and collaboration with key museum partners including the International Council of Museums (ICOM) and regional professional museum networks, ICCROM, UNESCO Chairs and other networks, major museums, and other stakeholders to support Member States in the safeguarding and development of museums and collections.
Targeted interventions will aim to support Member States with strengthening museum education, outreach and inclusion, as well as the protection of museums and collections in emergencies to ensure that museums continue to serve as vital institutions for preserving heritage and fostering inclusive cultural exchange.
UNESCO Museum Secretariat will facilitate communications and strengthen synergies for the Museum Programme through the organization of intersectoral task force meetings, regular meetings with UNESCO Chairs related to museums, and coordination meetings with key museum partners.
The Secretariat will ensure active monitoring and reporting to UNESCO Governing bodies on actions to support Member States with implementation of the 2015 Museum Recommendation.
